# ankra_proxmox_storages (Data Source)

The storages of a Proxmox VE node, for `storage` on `ankra_proxmox_cluster`. The counterpart of `ankra cluster proxmox storages`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_proxmox_storages" "pve1" {
  credential_id = ankra_proxmox_credential.lab.id
  node          = "pve1"
}

locals {
  image_storages = [for storage in data.ankra_proxmox_storages.pve1.storages : storage.storage if contains(storage.content, "images")]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credential_id` (String) Credential to read the catalogue through.
- `node` (String) Proxmox VE node (host) name (`data.ankra_proxmox_hosts`).

### Read-Only

- `storages` (Attributes List) Storages of the node. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storages))

<a id="nestedatt--storages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storages`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the storage is active.
- `available_bytes` (Number) Free space in bytes.
- `content` (List of String) Content types the storage holds, e.g. `images`.
- `shared` (Boolean) Whether the storage is shared between nodes.
- `storage` (String) Storage name.
- `total_bytes` (Number) Total space in bytes.
- `type` (String) Storage type, e.g. `lvmthin`.
